pages.text: END closes a code block.$(br2)It has the same x as its BEGIN. The keyword that opened the block follows it, like $(1)END FUNCTION$() or $(1)END WHILE$(). In an IF with an ELSE, the first END stands alone. After $(1)END REPEAT$() comes the loop condition.
Turn one BEGIN block into an END block.
$(1)FUNCTION answer$(br)  RESULT result INTEGER$(br)BEGIN$(br)  ASSIGN result 42 ;$(br)END FUNCTION$()
